text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the Zoning By-law Amendment application for a 60-storey mixed-use building with commercial uses, a community centre and a paramedic post within the first 2 floors and 848 residential dwelling units above. A total of 30 percent of the dwelling units are proposed to be provided as affordable rental. The application has been circulated to all appropriate City divisions and public agencies for comment. A Community Consultation Meeting for the application was held on March 7, 2022.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Received the report (March 24, 2022) from the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District, for information.
